name: promotion-provider
title: Promotion provider
description: Loads and sanitises promotions, keeps time to the exact start and end, applies dismissal, once-per-visit and one-floating-surface rules, waits for engagement without interrupting, and reports impressions, clicks, copies and dismissals.
docs: Pass your router's pathname and, for client-side navigation, your Link as `linkComponent`. A `{ load }` source runs once per mount; change `sourceKey` to reload. Translate every string with `labels`. Set `--promo-highlight` and `--promo-highlight-foreground` to theme the highlight tone.
